title: Consolidate committed creature fixture corpus
description: The repository's committed Assets/Creatures corpus contains multiple explicitly named backup and temporary snapshots alongside canonical creature fixtures. Several are byte-identical duplicates (for example body_creature.json/body_creature_bak.json and first_creature.json/first_creature_bak.json), while the dino corpus contains a sequence of bak/bak2/.../bak7 files plus temp pre/post snapshots. No current task owns fixture-corpus normalization. Audit and classify every committed creature JSON by purpose, preserve any file that is an active regression/manual-repro input, eliminate or relocate redundant historical copies only after repository-reference checks, and establish a small canonical fixture policy so the Unity asset tree does not become an accidental versioned backup store. Do not change fixture contents or delete files until references and test coverage are inventoried.
